text_block_list.text: I wonder...  Oh, is my bow crooked?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Nope, it's perfect!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I see Сайленс Судзука and her friends in
the dance
studio. They're doing a dress
rehearsal for the
celebration concert.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, should we make sure we can do all
our
dance moves properly in these
outfits?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Good idea. Let's rehearse "Never
Looking Back."
I'll go call the backup
dancers!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun! Everyone's moves
were
really cool!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It was like a sea of blue in the
mirror...
And when we danced we looked
like rolling waves
of blue and white.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Wow... It made my heart beat so fast.
That's how
the audience is going to see
us, huh...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
We better make sure our singing is on
par with
our dance skills!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: ...Is that really enough though?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: What do you mean?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
This celebration concert is different from
winning
concerts, right? It's a super
special event...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
And it's like someone once said, "A show
is
incomplete until the audience is
involved." It'll
probably be kinda like
that.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...I think I get it. The real thing will feel

completely different from practice.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Oh, so how about we try to imagine what
it's
going to be like during the actual
show?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Then we can sing our hearts out, like it's
the real
deal!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Visualization training! I think that's a
wonderful
idea. Let's try it.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the concert, and we're
waiting just
off stage... I think the
opening announcement
could be any
second now...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's the announcement! Oooh...
Gosh, I'm
so nervous...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...Finally, the music's turned down.
Listen, the
whole venue's practically
silent.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
There's the opening movie playing... And
it's over.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Okay, it's time for the concert! Let's hit
the stage!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
We stand onstage and before us is... a
sea of
lights, a rainbow of colors.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: It's so beautiful...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I can hear the audience clapping for us...
Oh my
gosh, I'm getting goosebumps!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Within the sea of lights is the crowd...
It's an
incredible sight. Seeing that
scenery, I feel a
power welling up inside
me, as if I could soar up
into the air.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I feel like I can sing until the end
of time!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Well, it was all in our imagination, so I'm
not sure
how the crowd looked... but I
hope they smile
during the real show.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Oh, we're gonna put smiles on all their faces!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I hope we put on a performance
even
more wonderful than we can
imagine.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Okay, once more from the top!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The singers practice with all their
passion. The
celebration concert is set to
be as fiery and
intense as the summer
sun itself!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
